preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
The number of existing roads m is between 0 and 5000 inclusive.
The capital city index s is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(roads) == m and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: There are exactly m roads, each connecting distinct cities u and v within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output is the integer representing the minimum number of new one-way roads required to make all cities reachable from the capital s.

postconditions.expression: min_roads_needed == len([c for c in condensation_nodes if not reachable_from_s_in_dag(c)])
postconditions.description: The minimum number of roads equals the count of strongly connected components (SCCs) in the condensation graph that are not reachable from the SCC containing s, assuming optimal connections are made to merge unreachable components into the reachable set.
